stem: Which of these sentences can BEST follow and support sentence 15?

options.label: A
options.text: She would help keep the rope tight and make sure Jared was safe coming down.

options.label: B
options.text: Andrea had been such a good friend, and looking down at her right now made Jared think of all the fun they had had.

options.label: C
options.text: Jared was feeling great and stepped back from the cliff to look around at all the beautiful scenery.

options.label: D
options.text: Andrea was right there, connected to the rope that Jared was connected to at the bottom of the cliff.
